name: askone
description: Run your AskOne live Q&A from Claude: start rooms, launch polls, moderate and answer questions, then draft a FAQ from them.
long_description: AskOne is live Q&A and polling for talks, webinars, classes and meetings. This extension lets Claude run your organization's rooms: list them, create, open and close rooms, add and launch polls, quizzes, ratings and word clouds, close polls, approve or hide waiting questions, mark questions answered with a written answer, read a room's questions as a Markdown FAQ draft, and read poll results. It cannot ask questions, vote or delete anything. An organization admin creates the API token in AskOne: organization switcher, Manage, API tokens; tokens created before the host actions shipped can only read.

tools.name: list_rooms
tools.description: List your organization's rooms, newest first, with question and participant counts.

tools.name: get_room_qa
tools.description: Read a room's questions as a Markdown FAQ draft.

tools.name: get_room_questions
tools.description: Read one page of a room's questions as JSON, with ids.

tools.name: get_survey_results
tools.description: Read aggregate poll, quiz, rating and word-cloud results.

tools.name: create_room
tools.description: Create a room, open or prepared.

tools.name: open_room
tools.description: Open a prepared room or reopen a closed one.

tools.name: close_room
tools.description: Close a room and its live polls.

tools.name: create_survey
tools.description: Add and launch a poll, quiz, rating or word cloud.

tools.name: close_survey
tools.description: Close a poll and choose whether the audience may see its results.

tools.name: moderate_question
tools.description: Approve or hide a waiting question.

tools.name: answer_question
tools.description: Mark a question answered, with an optional written answer.

api_token.title: AskOne API token
api_token.description: Created by an organization admin in AskOne: organization switcher → Manage → API tokens.

base_url.title: AskOne URL
